meta.name: Immersive Editorial Landing Page Design System
meta.purpose: Context for AI code generators (Cursor, etc.) to reproduce a consistent, photo-driven, premium landing page style for any travel/lifestyle/outdoor/hospitality-type brand. Content-agnostic: swap copy, imagery and brand colors, keep structure, spacing, radii, hierarchy and mood.
stack_recommendation: Tailwind CSS (extend theme with tokens below)
meta.mood: Calm, aspirational, warm, trustworthy. Large cinematic photography balanced by generous cream whitespace and restrained UI chrome.

design_principles: Photography is the hero. The page background itself is a full-bleed photograph; UI sits on top as floating layers.
Layering creates depth: background photo > floating cream content panel > inset hero image > floating search bar > cards.
Everything is rounded. No sharp corners on containers, images, inputs or buttons.
Restrained palette: one warm neutral surface, one deep dark accent (primary action), one warm highlight accent (marketing CTA). Imagery supplies all other color.
Text over images is always white, bold, and sits on a darkened area or gradient scrim for legibility.
Large bold tight-tracked headlines, small quiet supporting copy.
Generous padding and breathing room; low information density.
Soft, diffuse shadows only. No hard borders except 1px hairlines on ghost elements.

color.note: Approximate values sampled from the reference. Replace brand colors while preserving roles and contrast relationships.

surface.page_background: Full-bleed photographic image (landscape/nature, cool greens and blues), fixed or cover-sized

font_family.character: Modern geometric/neo-grotesque sans, friendly and slightly rounded, strong at heavy weights

spacing.page_outer_gutter: 24px (mobile) / 24-32px (desktop) between viewport edge and floating panel

border.panel_outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9) (thin light outline around the main floating panel)

iconography.style: outline, 1.5px stroke, rounded caps and joins
iconography.arrow_icons: Right arrow inside buttons; diagonal up-right arrow inside circular card chips

layout.overall_structure: Single long vertical page composed of a full-bleed photo background, with a large rounded cream panel floating inside it (inset from viewport edges). Header sits above the panel on the photo. Footer/outro sits below the panel on the photo with a dark green tinted overlay.
layout.max_content_width: 1200px (panel can span nearly full width with 24px outer margin on desktop up to ~1400px)
z_order: 1: dark gradient tint over lower portion of background for footer legibility
3: inset hero image (inside panel top, bleeds to panel edges with matching rounded top corners)
4: floating search bar overlapping bottom edge of hero image
5: header/nav (absolute over background photo, above panel)
vertical_order: Hero image with overlaid headline, subtext, primary CTA
Search bar overlapping hero bottom edge
Featured collection section (heading column + horizontal card row)
Outro / footer on photo (centered logo, tagline, decorative badge, script accent)

header.position: absolute top, full width, z-index above panel
header.background: transparent (no bar, text sits directly on photo)
header.left: Logo mark (simple geometric outline icon) + uppercase wide-tracked wordmark in white
header.center: Horizontal nav links, gap 24-28px, white 14px medium
header.right: Ghost pill button (outline white, transparent fill, 'Sign In') + solid warm-accent pill button ('Join')
header.mobile: Collapse nav into hamburger; keep logo left, primary CTA right

main_panel.padding_top: 0 (hero image is flush to panel top and sides, inset ~6px with its own radius)

hero.container: Rounded image block inside panel, height ~480px desktop / 420px mobile, border-radius 24px, overflow hidden
hero.image: Wide cinematic landscape photo, object-fit cover, subject placed right of center so left side stays calm for text

text_block.position: absolute left 40px, vertically around 40-55% of hero height
elements: H1: two lines, hero_headline style, white
Primary CTA: warm-accent pill with trailing arrow icon

search_bar.role: Primary conversion component. Floats over the seam between hero image and panel body.
search_bar.position: absolute, centered horizontally, bottom: -32px relative to hero (overlaps hero and panel)
search_bar.layout: flex row, align-center, 3 field groups separated by 1px vertical dividers (height 32px, rgba(0,0,0,0.12)), then a dark pill submit button

field_group.structure: [icon chip] + [stack: small label above, muted placeholder/value below]
field_group.flex: 1 for first two groups, auto for guest group

search_bar.mobile: Stack fields vertically inside a rounded-3xl white card; full-width submit button

logo_strip.layout: flex row, justify-between (or space-around), align-center, wraps on mobile
logo_strip.padding: 56px 40px 24px (top padding accounts for overlapping search bar)
logo_strip.item: Simple outline icon + uppercase wide-tracked name with a tiny sub-label beneath

section_with_card_carousel.layout: CSS grid, 2 columns: left text column ~ 280px, right card row fills remainder. Collapses to stacked on mobile.

elements: Short accent line: 48px wide, 2px tall, warm accent color, above heading
Carousel controls pinned to the bottom of the column
left_column.alignment: heading block vertically centered/upper, controls at bottom

carousel_controls.prev: ghost circle: transparent, 1px hairline border, muted gray arrow (disabled-looking state)
carousel_controls.next: solid circle: primary_dark background, white arrow

card_row.layout: flex row, gap 16px, overflow-x auto with scroll-snap, hide scrollbar
card_row.visible_cards: 3 on desktop, 1.2 on mobile (peek next card)

buttons.focus: 2px offset ring using accent_warm at 60% opacity

footer_outro.background: Continuation of the background photo with a dark green gradient tint (transparent at top to ~85% opaque at bottom)
elements: Decorative circular text badge at bottom-left: ~84px circle, 1px white border, repeating uppercase micro-text on a circular path, small icon in center, ~90% white
Handwritten script accent at bottom-right: 3-4 short words stacked, rotated about -8deg, display_script font, white, with a short underline stroke beneath

imagery_guidelines.style: High-resolution, cinematic, warm natural light, rich saturated greens and blues, shallow atmospheric depth, golden-hour feel
imagery_guidelines.hero_composition: Wide landscape; main subject offset to one side; calm negative space on the opposite side for text
imagery_guidelines.card_composition: Portrait crops, subject centered or lower-center, bottom 40% tolerant of dark gradient overlay
imagery_guidelines.background_composition: Vertical full-bleed scene with sky at top fading into foliage/water/rock textures toward bottom; bottom region must darken well for footer text
consistency_rules: Keep a warm, natural color grade across all images
Avoid people looking at camera; prefer scenery and environment
All images cropped with object-fit: cover, never stretched

responsive_behavior.desktop: Floating panel with 24-32px outer gutter; search bar horizontal; 3 cards visible; heading column left of cards.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Heading column stacks above card row; 2 cards visible plus peek; logo strip may wrap to 3+2.
responsive_behavior.mobile: Panel margin 12px; hero headline scales down to ~44px; search bar becomes stacked card; logo strip becomes horizontal scroll; cards 1.2 visible; nav collapses to hamburger.

accessibility.contrast: White text on images requires scrim reaching at least 4.5:1; verify over lightest image regions
accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on all pills, inputs and icon buttons
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling parallax, hover scale and reveal animations
accessibility.semantics: Use header/nav/main/section/footer landmarks; carousel buttons with aria-labels; images with descriptive alt text; search as role=search form

do: Always start with a full-bleed photographic background and place a rounded cream panel on top of it.
Make the hero an inset rounded image with left-aligned white bold headline, short subtext and one pill CTA.
Overlap a white pill-shaped search/booking bar across the bottom edge of the hero.
Use pill shapes for all buttons and inputs; use 20-28px radii for cards and panels.
Use exactly one dark accent (primary actions) and one warm accent (marketing CTAs, small accent rules).
Overlay text on images only with a gradient scrim.
Use uppercase, widely tracked text for logos and wordmarks.
Include a single handwritten script accent and a circular badge as decorative flourishes in the footer.
Keep sections sparse: one clear heading, one line of copy, one visual row.
dont: Do not use hard borders, sharp corners, heavy drop shadows or gradients on buttons.
Do not introduce additional accent colors or colorful UI illustrations.
Do not use dense text blocks, tables or multi-column body copy.
Do not place text over images without a scrim.
Do not use stock-icon fills; stay with thin outline icons.
adaptation_rules: To retheme: change the background photo, primary_dark, accent_warm and panel colors. Keep the lightness relationships (panel very light, primary_dark very dark, accent mid-tone).
To change industry (e.g. real estate, wellness, restaurants, events): keep layout and component anatomy, swap search fields and card content.
Search bar fields are configurable: 2-4 fields, each with icon chip + label + value, then a dark submit pill.
Card carousels may show 3-4 items; always keep image-first cards with bottom-left text and top-right circular action chip.

section_recipes.hero_plus_search: panel > hero(image, scrim, text-left, CTA) + search_bar(overlap bottom)
section_recipes.social_proof: logo_strip with 4-6 monochrome logos, uppercase wordmarks
section_recipes.featured_collection: grid[heading_column(accent_rule, h2, subtext, circular prev/next), card_row(3x image_card)]
section_recipes.outro: centered wordmark + tagline + circular badge (left) + script accent (right) over darkened photo

example_prompt_for_cursor: Using the attached design-system.json, build a [PAGE TYPE] for [BRAND] in Next.js + Tailwind. Follow layout.vertical_order and the components specs exactly. Use my brand colors in place of tokens.color.brand and my own imagery. Keep all radii, spacing, typography scale and the layered floating-panel composition unchanged.
